test_toolset_validation: test a Boost.Build toolset by running the mock compiler against a set of property configurations
expand_properties_with_defaults: expand a list of build properties by adding default values for variant, threading, and link
compute_build_output_path: compute the expected output file path based on build properties, toolset, and target type
get_property_value: get the value of a named property from a list of key=value build properties
check_property_exists: check whether a given property name exists in a list of build properties
